newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures pare gains late, still up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures pare gains late, still up.

text.p: June 13 - U.S. stock index futures pared gains late, stayed up. Sept S&P 500s edged off, hit small sellstops on decline that respected intraday support at 900.40. They said ability of T-bond futures to end firm, albeit below highs, kept stocks supported. Sept S&Ps treaded Friday on both sides of resistance at 905.10 area. Some looked for more late buying.
